snippet.title: Encased Preview Trailer
snippet.description:
Encased is a tactical sci-fi RPG set in an alternative 1970's, where an enormous and inexplicable artifact – the Dome – is discovered in a remote desert. Fight enemies, explore the anomalous wasteland, level up your character and join one of the forces in the ruined world.

Buy on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/921800/Encased_A_SciFi_PostApocalyptic_RPG/
Buy on GOG: https://www.gog.com/game/encased_a_scifi_postapocalyptic_rpg
Buy on EGS: https://www.epicgames.com/store/ru/p/encased

Join our Discord server:
https://discord.gg/56RFZTV

Watch Dev Updates:
